result_summary.description:
Users in the ANZ production environment are encountering 'rate limit exceeded' errors when using the SSO Integration Module. This prevents successful login attempts for a portion of our user base.

The issue affects approximately 28 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to determine if the current rate limits are too aggressive for our traffic volume or if there is an abnormal spike in requests causing this throttling.
